messages:
AJ: Heads up — planning engine/kernels bump to 2.4.1 + quant profile q-prof-v3 tonight. Target window 22:30-23:30 UTC. Need deploy owner, smoke checklist confirmation, and rollback plan. Can someone take point? :eyes:
Maria: I can take deploy owner if Sam ok with smoke verifications. What's the canary size?
Sam: I can run the smoke/perf scripts and collect metrics. Recommend 5% canary to start, hold 20m then 25% if ok.
Kevin: FYI storage/kv-cache layout changed in 2.4.1 — add `--kv-migrate=false` to the canary to avoid background migration. I'll post short note in runbook.
Lucy: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/engine-upgrades — see "preflight checks" section. Also add latency SLIs and token-cost check.
AJ: copying preflight commands:
```
./tools/deploy_engine --image engine:2.4.1 --quant q-prof-v3 --canary 5
./tools/smoke_check.sh --endpoint $CANARY_URL --duration 10m
```
Sam: ack — I'll kick off canary at 22:30 UTC and paste results. Which metrics to include? p95 latency, 99th, tokens/sec, error-rate, memory RSS.
Kevin: include kernel/gpu utilization and kv-cache hit rate. If p99 regresses >200ms or error-rate >0.5% rollback immediately.
Maria: Rollback plan: revert image to engine:2.4.0 and profile q-prof-v2, scale back canary to 0%, then run smoke_check. Rollback commands:
```
./tools/deploy_engine --image engine:2.4.0 --quant q-prof-v2 --canary 0
kubectl rollout status deploy/engine --namespace prod
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window reserved 2026-04-12 22:30 UTC — ticket #INC-1423 :white_check_mark:
oncall-rot: I'm oncall that window. prefer 22:00 start for extra buffer. if we need me to run any step ping @oncall-rot.
AJ: okay moved to 22:00-23:00 UTC. Maria will own deploy, Sam smoke, Kevin rollback ready. I'll post a short summary in the release channel 30m prior. :rocket:
Sam: quick question — need any code-review approvals for the deploy script change? pinging @Lucy for final sign-off.
Lucy: approved. Reviewed the changes earlier; no blockers. :+1:
AJ: perfect — thanks all. I'll post canary link when started.
